biggest_catch: Payment lags ~6 weeks: shops submitted 1st-15th are paid on the 1st of the second following month; 16th-31st on the 15th of the second following month.
catches: ~6-week payment lag per official two-cycle schedule.
Banking shops may require good credit (hard inquiries) — a real financial cost reported by shoppers.
Reports are long and detailed for modest fees.
Heavy scam impersonation: fake ATH checks circulate — real company pays via Checkbook.io email after completed work, never mails checks upfront.

c3.evidence: Official FAQ: payments released twice a month in two cycles — reports submitted 1st-15th paid on the 1st of the second following month; 16th-31st paid on the 15th of the second following month.

steps: Create a free apc shopper account on athpower.com and complete the Extended Shopper Profile
Browse and accept bank/retail mystery shopping assignments
Complete the shop and submit the detailed report
Receive a Checkbook.io email with your digital check on the payment cycle date
Choose mobile deposit, printable check, paper check, or direct deposit
timing: Two payment cycles per month: reports submitted 1st-15th paid on the 1st of the second following month; reports submitted 16th-31st paid on the 15th of the second following month.
maximize: Do your shops early in the month — the pay date is set by when you submit, so a report filed on the 16th waits almost two months. In Checkbook.io pick ACH/direct deposit for the fastest access to your money.
